text: Ext¹_R(M, N) has a concrete interpretation as:
choices: equivalence classes of extensions 0 → N → E → M → 0, with the split extension as the zero element
the group of homomorphisms M → N
the chain homotopy classes of projective resolutions of M
explanation: Extensions are added by the Baer sum, and an extension is trivial in Ext¹ exactly when it splits, i.e. E ≅ N ⊕ M. Thus Ext¹(M, N) = 0 says every extension of M by N splits.
